meta_description:
3,223 likes, 24 comments - rekhta_foundation on September 30, 2026: "Dubai, get ready for history in the making—tickets are OFFICIALLY LIVE!

A.R. Rahman and Javed Akhtar are coming to the Rekhta stage for two massive live shows. Join us at the Dubai Media City Amphitheatre on December 12th and 13th, 2026, for a huge weekend.

Saturday, 12 December (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM GST)
Opening the weekend: Noor-e-Ishq. Get ready for an evening of Sufi music led by A.R. Rahman. Expect a massive live performance.

Sunday, 13 December (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM GST)
Return for Sada Bahaar Geetkaar—a live tribute show featuring Javed Akhtar, Meiyang Chang, and Jahnvi Shrimankar.

Secure your spot today!

🎟️ Tickets are available now on Platinumlist. - Link in our story

🌐 Bookings & Event Details: rekhtainternational.com

✉️ Official Inquiries: info@rekhtainternational.com

#ShaameRekhtaDubai #ARRahman #DubaiEvents #JavedAkhtar #SufiMusic".
